step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram and transcript depict Kinaï's medical imaging AI platform. Hospital actors upload medical images (~5TB per project) to an input S3 bucket. Pathologists and hospitals access a labeling product running on AWS EKS to annotate and label the images. The labeled data in S3 and control triggers from EKS feed into AWS SageMaker for machine learning model training. SageMaker uses FSx for high I/O performance during training and IAM for access control and HDS certification compliance. Trained model artifacts are exported to a model storage S3 bucket and loaded back into EKS for pathologist validation and active inference.
